metric: CPU/op or throughput >=3% (paired95%CI excludes zero), alternatively >=10% B/op reduction with <=2% CPU regression
mechanism: transport-owned pooled scalar/header prefix+suffix for <=256-byte native v3/v4 prepared frames; canonical values retain original borrowed spans; avoids generic scalar slab/builder descriptors while immutable chain indices remain per-write
lifetime: No public retained frame API uses scratch. Cancellation before write releases immediately; accepted writes retain scratch until InternalWriteSpans synchronously completes, including coalesced writes and partial I/O.
